verification_method: AI-assisted transcription checked against rendered original Tables 2-5, followed by condition-keyed comparison to archived ChEMBL records.
scope: Only the acetazolamide CA II column in Tables 2-5; not the CA IX columns or all 54 acetazolamide records.
endpoint_locator: p. 1901, paragraph following Table 5, explicitly reports IC50 rather than calculating Ki; p. 1902, note 13(b), defines 50% activity reduction.
assay: Stopped-flow CO2 hydration, 25 degrees C; recombinant human CA II produced in E. coli.
method_locator: Tables 2-5 captions and footnotes, pp. 1900-1901; note 13(b), p. 1902.
buffer: 10 mM HEPES, pH 7.4; 0.1 M Na2SO4 or NaClO4; 0.2 mM phenol red monitored at 557 nm.
replication: Each tabulated value is a mean of three assays; reported errors are within +/-5%, without designation as SD, SE, or CI.
shared_reference: The 0 mM, 8.9 nM CA II reference occurs in all four tables and is represented once, not treated as four independent measurements.
mechanism_boundary: Ternary-complex formation is a hypothesis in the paper, not demonstrated by this audit.
redistribution: The user-supplied publisher PDF is not included in public code or data exports. The cited numerical transcription and source locators support review.
